items.title: Eclipse Foundation Mandates Pre-Publish Security Checks for Open VSX Extensions
items.description: The Eclipse Foundation, which maintains the Open VSX Registry, has announced plans to enforce security checks before Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extensions are published to the open-source repository to combat supply chain threats.
